gist.headline: A new studio is blooming
gist.blurb: Pollen Image Studio has joined the garden: a simple online image generator running on the Pollinations image API. Bring a prompt; leave with pixels.
gist.summary: Added Pollen Image Studio (image.lanprint.com), an online AI image generator powered by the Pollinations image API, to the supported app directory.
gist.impact: People looking for a ready-to-use Pollinations-powered image tool can now discover Pollen Image Studio directly through the project’s app listings.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy pixel-art image studio as a garden shed: Polli is helping a friendly CRT monitor robot turn a written prompt into a framed pastel landscape, with image-pixels blooming from code-plants. The studio represents the newly listed Pollen Image Studio app and should feel like a welcoming place for anyone to make images.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art scene inside a tiny garden image studio, where Polli—the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blush, light blue rounded wings, and a tiny painter’s beret—warmly helps a chunky CRT monitor robot create a framed AI landscape from a prompt card; pixel flowers and code-plants grow around a prominently lime green (#ecf874) glowing screen reading “IMAGE STUDIO.” Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
